content: This is Agent Harris with the IRS Investigations Unit. I am calling regarding irregularities in your federal tax filings from the last two years. Can you confirm your name for the record?
Uh, yes, this is Riley Morgan... Is there a problem? I just graduated last spring and I'm not sure I understand.

Riley, our records show multiple discrepancies and unpaid taxes associated with your Social Security Number. The IRS takes unpaid taxes extremely seriously. When did you last file your federal income taxes?
I think my dad helped me file them last year, but I'm not really sure how everything works. Is something wrong with my return?
According to our audit, your returns show substantial underreported income, which has resulted in a tax debt of $7,300. With late penalties and accrued interest, the total now exceeds $9,000.
Oh no, I don't have that kind of money! What happens if I can't pay it right now?

If this debt is not immediately resolved, the IRS will proceed with wage garnishment, freezing of your bank accounts, and a formal criminal complaint. We may also revoke your driver's license and recommend federal charges.
Wait, are you saying I could be arrested? I don't understand, I thought this was a mistake.

The case is already flagged as 'Delinquent & Fraudulent Filing.' If you do not comply within the next hour, a federal arrest warrant will be issued in your name, and local authorities will be notified.
Please, I can't get in trouble! My credit is already bad from student loans. What do I need to do to fix this?

You must settle the remaining balance immediately to stop enforcement action. The IRS is accepting payment today either via instant wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or prepaid gift cards for urgent settlements. Do you have access to any of these methods right now?
I have a debit card, but I don't know how to send crypto. I could try to buy a gift card at a store, but I'm not sure how it works.

That's fine, Riley. I need you to stay on the line with me. Go to the nearest pharmacy or grocery store and purchase $2,000 worth of Apple or Target gift cards, as that is the minimum payment required to halt the arrest warrant for today.
Do I need to tell the cashier what it's for? This seems weird for taxes.

Do NOT discuss this with anyone at the store. If you reveal this is for the IRS, it will be considered a breach of confidentiality, and the case may escalate. Tell them it's for personal use if asked.
Okay, I guess I can try to go to the Walgreens down the street. What do I do once I get the cards?
Stay on the call. Once you purchase the gift cards, read me the numbers on the back immediately. This will allow us to process your payment and freeze any further legal action for today.
What if I can't get that much right now? My bank account is almost empty after rent.
Any delay, even of a few minutes, will result in the case progressing to the next enforcement phase. Even a partial payment shows your willingness to cooperate. How much can you get at this moment?
Maybe I can do $1,000 if my card doesn't decline. Is that enough to stop the warrant for now?
If you provide $1,000 in gift cards now and commit to the remaining $1,000 within the next 24 hours, I can place the warrant on temporary hold. But if you fail, the full enforcement resumes.
Okay, I'm leaving for the store now. Please don't arrest me or freeze my accounts, I'm really scared.
Remain calm and follow instructions. Once you have the cards, do NOT hang up. Read me the redemption codes on the back and this will secure your account from further penalties today.
